subject.title: Remote skill bin probe times out when node is co-located with gateway (macOS app as node on same host)

question: Should the remaining repair focus on a narrow active-runtime remote-bin probe readiness/backoff/co-location change, or should maintainers first require a fresh live macOS repro and replacement for the stale/conflicting related PRs?
rationale: Current main has only partially mitigated the original default-command problem, while the remaining fix crosses app-node command contracts, probe timing policy, and two imperfect candidate PRs; automation should not choose that product boundary alone.

options.title: Narrow Active-Runtime Fix
options.body: Keep the app-node exec contract intact, implement the probe timing or co-location rule in `src/skills/runtime/remote.ts`, and require real macOS proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Adopt A Candidate PR
options.body: Ask contributors or ClawSweeper to replace or port https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/79438 or split the useful part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83980 before review continues.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause repair until a maintainer can capture current-main co-located and remote macOS app-node probe behavior on real hardware.

recommendation.title: Narrow Active-Runtime Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the app-node exec contract intact, implement the probe timing or co-location rule in `src/skills/runtime/remote.ts`, and require real macOS proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent already made the related app-node command-contract decision on the closed unmerged PR, so he is the clearest current owner for whether to preserve, narrow, or replace the remaining fix path.
